HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.
   D. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
